Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Unimpeachable Name
Cards.Text:
Reaction: Before the resolution of another player's action: Reduce each Honor loss from its effects by 3 (minimum 0). You may target and rehonor a dishonorable Personality.
Battle: Bow your performing Shugenja and target an enemy card: Bow it. Gain 2 Honor.

Cards.Name: Fields of Mercy
Cards.Text:
Before a card effect destroys a Personality in an army, if a card effect has destroyed another Personality in that army while this card was in play: Negate the Personality's destruction.
Battle: If there are no Terrains at the current battlefield: Put this card into play there.
